latum: id solum (inter alia minora quæ no-
vari voluerant) acerrimè urgebant, Abolen-
Cætera omnia quovis tempore propositā,
vel nihil omnino facientia ad Belli causam, vel
a Me facile concessa, vel denique erant huj-
usmodi quæ Numerum tantum implebant,
aut accedebant postea ut confecutiva Belli jam
ab illis Injuste inchoati.
Penes me non est quid alii credant efficere,
(ii præcipuè, quos illa species Pietatis &
Clamor, tum studium Religionis, & Reformandi
fervor ita occupant plerunque Præjudicio, ut
lux omnis Judicii, & æquitas simul obstrua-
tur.) Hæc tamen (quantum observare potui)
vera fuit & est inter nos controversia, & Armor-
um Causa, quæ hoc fine, in initio ceperunt,
ut vel os mihi penitus occluderent, vel con-
sensum vi exprimerent. Et in hac porro Ve-
ritate, (quam Deo Teste confirmo) tam re-
motum me fuisse a Belli Cogitatione, quam

page.notes: The running head is printed in Greek capitals (ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ); some letters in the scan are close to Latin shapes, so the Greek reading is a best reading. The asterisk in the left margin beside "Penes" is a printer's mark, not a note. The right edge shows show-through and the neighbouring page, not transcribed. The page ends with the hyphenated "cala-" and the catchword "mitofis" completes it on the next page.
